about: The first-load hint box's words and timing, by what a zone IS, not by which zone it is (Dom 2026-10-22: 700 zones must not each carry copy). `traits` is keyed by a trait derived from the zone's own rows (origins/preview/hint-copy.ts): `creatures` = its spawn rows are not empty, `noCreatures` = they are. A zone that wants its own words adds a row to legend-copy.json `zoneHints`, which wins over these. `timing.hint.dismissSec` is how long the box stays up when the player has not moved a thumb (the box also goes at the first move).

creatures.walk: Left stick walks. Push to the edge to run. Walk up to a creature and tap STRIKE (slide to stab or slash, hold for heavy) to fight it. Drag empty screen to look round when the camera lock is off.
creatures.watch: Left stick walks. Push to the edge to run. Creatures stop and watch when you come near.

noCreatures.walk: Left stick walks. Push to the edge to run. Drag empty screen to look round when the camera lock is off.
noCreatures.watch: Left stick walks. Push to the edge to run.
